mentions.name: CentralCI
mentions.description: Fully-managed Concourse CI as a service. Provides dedicated Concourse instances on high-spec hardware (Ice Lake Xeon, DDR5, NVMe), worker scaling without Kubernetes complexity, SOC compliance with auditing and AWS PrivateLink for enterprise, and 24/7 support. Highlights Concourse capabilities like fly execute for testing pipelines locally, fly intercept for debugging inside running containers, resource-based triggers that can monitor anything (not just git pushes), full dev-to-prod pipeline visualization, and fully controllable workers.
mentions.problem: Concourse is the right tool for complex CI/CD, but running and maintaining it is a pain for enterprises; the builders spent years deploying and maintaining Concourse for companies and productized that operational knowledge.
mentions.audience: Enterprises and development teams that run complex CI/CD pipelines, such as Starbucks, Accenture, and Sky UK
